contract.question: Which committed EMC expression cohorts can test the published CHRNA6 reference signal, and which comparisons fail because of assay coverage, absent comparator data or unresolved sample independence?
contract.stop_condition: Produce a source-keyed JSON readiness matrix, deterministic audit script and concise go/no-go memo. Stop after independent source-pointer and count verification. No new expression analysis or manuscript.

clinical_relevance.basis: Avoid mistaking diagnostic RNA evidence for target availability and prevent unusable validation claims.

answerability.basis: Committed cohort metadata and probe maps can answer availability; unknown identity remains unknown.

validation.basis: Independent enumeration of identifiers and source pointers; published CISH is orthogonal assay evidence, not an independent array.

information_gain.basis: A reusable map connects previously separate artifacts; stop if already complete.

contract.instructions: Audit only committed inputs. Record exact JSON pointers and SHA256 for every reported sample ID, cohort, platform, comparator count and CHRNA6 probe/gene availability. Distinguish runs, specimens and patients; deduplicate exact identifiers only and label cross-study identity unresolved unless documented. An absent CHRNA6 row in a selected-gene cache is not missing platform coverage. Mark coverage not_assessed when annotation is unavailable. Catalogue existing per-probe versus aggregated values and raw-data availability without downloading. No new biomarker estimates, rankings, p-values, correlations, survival models, clinical claims or full fusion calls. Primary-marker-evidence.json is abstract-level evidence; never invent supplementary tables or infer validation independence. State whether any committed data supports a later specified CHRNA6 expression comparison; if not, give exact missing inputs and stop. Enumerate counts via deterministic script and include explicit handling of unknowns. No network, installs, paid compute, figures, registry or manuscript edits. Use runner-supplied Python, medium effort, one dispatch/1800 seconds. Reuse existing outcomes. Coordinator independently checks counts and pointers before collection. If an equivalent complete mapping already exists, return its path and stop; do not fabricate novelty.
